tool_output.instruction: How can I edit and correct my Excel VBA code to combine data from the source sheet cdnr into the destination sheet b2b, sez, de, aligning columns by identical header text (not by column position), and appending the new rows below the existing data without overwriting any existing rows (i.e., start at the first empty row, which is row 7 in the provided file)? Amounts copied from the source must be written as negative values in the destination’s **columns L and M, while preserving the destination’s number formats. For each inserted row, set column H to blank and column I to "Credit Note". The macro must not clear or erase any existing data on b2b, sez, de.
